narr: A nearly stationary boundary just south of Lake Ontario divided a moist unstable air mass from a much cooler one. Instability was generating a CAPE of around 2000 J/Kg south of the boundary by late afternoon, but wind shear was limited with 700 hPa winds only around 20 knots. Some pulse storms began to develop by late afternoon, mainly out of our area. A convective wave approached from the Ohio Valley and passed just to our south through the evening. This likely enhanced wind shear, especially in the Southern Tier, where numerous warnings were issued. A portion of the line that developed briefly trained in Allegany County. This resulted in rainfall estimates of 2-3 inches from the radar and flash flooding there.
ev: Flooding was reported on Route 19 between Route 16 and White Creek Road.
lsr: FLOODING REPORTED ON WHITE CREEK RD. AND STATE ROUTE 19 BETWEEN CR 17 AND CR 16. MULTIPLE ROAD CLOSURES.
